title: EV era
note: EV era per docs/eras/ev.md and its "Decisions taken" (which rule), in two substages (its "Validator" section): ev, the automated Moon base and Earth's fine chemistry, and ev-mars, Mars reached at the end of the era with the tier 2 rocket (steam.json's eraOrder puts ev-mars between ev and iv, so nothing on the way to Mars may need tungsten, samarium or deuterium). The Moon is the HV trip's dim:gcyr:luna key; Mars is the dim:gcyr:mars key of the synthetic mars-trip (the advanced tank and motor, which need the antenna's Mars chart). Every recipe of the Moon machines (regolith cell, cryogenic plant, antenna, the tripod's lunar veins, the sealed dome's lunar mode) carries .dimension('gcyr:luna') and the Mars ones (atmosphere processor, Martian veins, Martian seed) .dimension('gcyr:mars'): static `site` checks, and conditions.dimension.asKeysFor turns them into the trips' keys. Machines: every EV single block (gtceu:ev_*), our EV multiblocks with their real patterns (B7's combined-cycle plant and hot strip mill included), GTM's EBF with nichrome, freezer, large chemical reactor and tower on EV hatches, and the family tier veto (vetoAbove/onlyTier: the tripod only runs vein_drilling/ev/, the lower drills and greenhouses skip it, and the steam drill and greenhouse only run unfiled steam recipes). Decisions of 2026-10-25 (C1): radioactives, radon and the quantum eye wait for IV (the Nether thorium gives no uraninite and red granite no uranium; Productive Bees' IV combs get no recipe until IV, since two EV hatches run 7,680 EU/t; the pack's EV circuit assembler and EV creature simulator take HV emitters and sensors).

dimension.note: The bases outside the factory: a recipe only valid on the Moon needs the dim:gcyr:luna key (HV's synthetic moon-trip) and one only valid on Mars the dim:gcyr:mars key (synthetic mars-trip), instead of being compared against the factory's dimension. GTM ORs a recipe's dimension conditions: a recipe for the Moon or Mars (the solar array's, the tripod's) needs either key.

world.note: The first visit to Mars (docs/eras/ev.md, "Mars, end of EV"): the trip's key brings back by hand 2 ores of each Martian vein the tripod's table offers (veins_mars.json: scheelite, merrillite and deuterium-rich ice; GCYR's own Mars veins are removed) for the samples, and the Martian ground. A one-off start: the tripod keeps it coming.

machines.note: EV -> IV transformer (4 A -> 1 A): the gate to IV.
Nichrome EBF with 2 EV hatches: they count as IV (8,192 V) and 3,900 K (3,600 K + 300 K for the three steps above MV): tungsten (3,600 K), tungsten steel and the RTM alloy.
GTM's vacuum freezer on 2 EV hatches (IV voltage): the hot tungsten, tungsten steel and RTM ingots and GTM's liquid oxygen and helium.
GTM's large chemical reactor on EV hatches: nitric acid from the elements (docs/eras/ev.md, fine chemistry) and the EV reactions of the nano line.
GTM's distillation tower on EV hatches: the cascade's diluted HCl back to HCl, and the EV distillations.
Platinum plant (ev/platinum_plant.js, Earth): 5x5x7 hall of inert casing; five recipes composed at load from GT--'s live line; every recipe needs grindless:platinum_electrode (chanced input, 0.1%).

Regolith cell (ev/regolith_cell.js, Moon): 5x5x4 hall of sintered regolith bricks (made only on the Moon) around a stable titanium crucible with nichrome coils, glass roof. Every recipe carries .dimension('gcyr:luna'). Circuit 1 volatiles (H2, He, N2, He-3), circuit 2 electrolysis (O2, Si, Fe; ilmenite -> titanium with grindless:platinum_electrode at 0.1% and grindless:molten_salt_charge never used up), circuit 3 sintering; all 1,920 EU/t.

Cryogenic plant (ev/cryogenic_plant.js, Moon): a 3x3x7 frost-proof tower with a titanium pipe core on sintered regolith and two wings of Night-Sky Radiators on aluminium frames. O2, He and N2 to their liquids at the vacuum freezer's 1,920 EU/t (half at night, a run-start modifier the validator doesn't see); every recipe carries .dimension('gcyr:luna'). The only source of liquid nitrogen.

EV Tripod Drill (ev/tripod.js, Moon and Mars): titanium frame legs on sintered regolith footings, a stable titanium body, a titanium pipe drill string and two wings of Solar Wing Panels. It runs gtceu:vein_drilling but only its own vein_drilling/ev/ recipes (onlyTier: the veto refuses every other tier folder), generated from the Moon and Mars vein tables, each with that dimension's condition; titanium drill bit, dry or with 50 mB of liquid nitrogen per bore.

Lunar solar array (ev/lunar_power_and_antenna.js): 36 Solar Wing Panels on titanium frame posts over sintered regolith, a regolith control hut with an input bus and 1-4 dynamo hatches. A generator with its own recipe type (lib/generators.js): by day, 420 EU/t per lit panel on the Moon and 129 on Mars, nothing consumed; the EU is the synthetic solar-array.

Deep space antenna (ev/lunar_power_and_antenna.js, Moon): a 7x7 titanium dish on a sintered regolith pedestal. At night on the Moon the lunar landing chart (not consumed) + a data stick -> the Mars chart, 1,920 EU/t; its only recipe carries .dimension('gcyr:luna').

Sealed dome (ev/sealed_dome.js, Moon and Mars): the greenhouse family's EV step, gtceu:greenhouse with circuits 0-3 as the HV greenhouse and circuit 4 for its sealed recipes (greenhouse/ev/*_sealed_moon with CO2 from home, *_sealed_mars with the air's), each with its dimension; it skips any folder above ev. Sintered regolith rings, a soil bed, tempered glass, GT lamps and an iron door.

Rare-earth extraction cascade (ev/extraction_cascade.js, Earth): a 3x3x7 line of mixer-settlers in inert casing. Circuit 1 leaches Martian merrillite with HCl into the chloride solution; circuit 2 separates it with kerosene and an HCl strip into samarium, neodymium and mixed chlorides (GTM's electrolyzer makes the metals). The only consumer of merrillite dust.

Atmosphere processor (ev/mars_site.js, Mars): stable titanium casing hall with an intake housing. Circuit 1 Sabatier (water from home + the air's CO2 -> methane + oxygen, ruthenium catalyst 0.1%), circuit 2 CO2 from the air; every recipe carries .dimension('gcyr:mars').

Combined-cycle plant (ev/combined_cycle_and_hot_mill.js, package B7, Earth): a generator with its own type (lib/generators.js, EU out) that takes the gas turbine's fuels + distilled water -> the same EU per fuel + steam for a steam turbine (+40% if one takes it; the plant stops if the steam has nowhere to go). 1-2 dynamo hatches of any tier; its 19 recipes copy the gas turbine's air allowlist (methalox has none). The EU is the synthetic combined-cycle: an extra eu:ev source, not a required one.

Hot strip mill (ev/combined_cycle_and_hot_mill.js, package B7, Earth): hot ingot + water -> plate, rods or foil + steam, 129 recipes generated from GTM's hot ingots (freezer + bender/extruder energy). Every product also comes from the freezer and the bender or extruder, so no target needs it.

synthetic.note: GTM's EV -> IV transformer on the EV grid: the 32,768 EU/t power station of the gate to IV (amperage isn't modeled).

The lunar solar array's daytime EU (420 EU/t per panel on the Moon, 129 on Mars; its two recipes carry the site's dimension and need nothing but a programmed circuit): EV power that burns no fuel, on the Moon or Mars.
The combined-cycle plant's EU (B7): any of the gas turbine's fuels + distilled water -> the same EU per fuel + steam. An extra EV source on Earth (methalox anywhere), not a required one.

The trip to Mars (docs/eras/ev.md, "Mars, end of EV"; integration/gcyr_mars_road.js): a tier 2 rocket (GCYR averages part tiers, so every tank and motor is advanced: both remade in the EV assembler with titanium and the antenna's Mars chart as a catalyst), the HV suit with oxygen, and 14 B of fuel. It gives the dim:gcyr:mars key, which the Martian ores need by hand (mars-ores) and the recipes only valid on Mars. Capital: the return is by waystone.

eraResources.note: Mars' scheelite vein (veins_mars.json) at the end of EV; tungsten steel opens IV. Exclusivity (EV, 2026-10-25): without Mars no tungsten key is reached (the End's scheelite vein is set aside, Productive Bees' tungsten, scheelite and tungstate combs only process on Mars, and alloy decompositions only give back what went in).

eraResources.label: merrillite (the Martian rare earths)
eraResources.note: veins_mars.json's merrillite vein (docs/eras/ev.md, "What only Mars gives"): it only comes from Mars and only the extraction cascade splits it.

eraResources.label: samarium (the cascade, from Martian merrillite)
eraResources.note: 2026-10-25: samarium leaves Earth (rare_earth_separation without it, GTCA's flsamaric_to_ho without the samarium-terbium mixture: offworld_only.json); the cascade gets it from Martian merrillite. Reserve for LuV's magnets.

eraResources.label: deuterium-rich ice (Mars)
eraResources.note: veins_mars.json's ice vein: stored in EV, melted and enriched into heavy water in IV.

eraResources.label: deuterium (IV's heavy water, from the Martian ice)
eraResources.note: 2026-10-25: hydrogen_separation is removed and both ender air recipes lose their deuterium, so nothing gives it in EV; only tritium separation and fusion (LuV) use it. IV makes heavy water from the Martian ice.

eraResources.label: radioactives and radon (IV)
eraResources.note: docs/eras/ev.md, "Nothing in EV requires anything from IV": radioactives, radon and quantum stars open IV. The End's pitchblende vein is held back until IV (veins_excluded.json); on Earth the Nether thorium gives lead and rare earths instead of GTM's uraninite, and the ender air distillation loses its radon (offworld_only.json, decision of 2026-10-25).

eraResources.label: quantum eye and quantum star (radon: IV)
eraResources.note: The EV emitter, sensor and field generator need a quantum eye (radon), so they stay in IV; the deep space antenna, the EV creature simulator and the pack's EV circuit assembler use HV ones (decisions of 2026-10-25), so the wither and the nano line need no radon.

eraItems.note: In EV (ev.json): GTM's HV field generator (and the world accelerator built on it) needs a quantum eye (radon, IV); GTM's HV fluid drilling rig needs titanium and tungsten carbide gears, so it arrives with Mars (group ev-mars).

eraItems.label: GTM's EV machines, parts and components (gtceu:ev_*; what needs a quantum eye or tungsten stays in IV)
eraItems.note: GTM's EV emitter, sensor and field generator need a quantum eye (radon, IV), and so do the laser engraver and the scanner built from them; the large miner needs tungsten gears and IV circuits. They stay in IV (docs/eras/ev.md). Decisions of 2026-10-25 (C1): the pack's EV circuit assembler (the nano line and the gate's nano computers) and EV creature simulator (the wither) take an HV emitter and sensor instead, so they are EV items.
